title: Great Purge
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Great Purge", at revision 1379376620, opens: "The Great Purge or Great Terror, also known as the Year of '37 and the Yezhovshchina, was a political purge in the Soviet Union from 1936 to 1939. After the assassination of Sergei Kirov by Leonid Nikolaev in 1934, Joseph Stalin launched a series of show trials known as the Moscow trials to remove suspected dissenters from the Communist Party of the Soviet Union." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q187650, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Soviet campaign of political repression, imprisonment, and execution (August 1936 - March 1938)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
